verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a financial SaaS platform, but the evidence pack never documents a way to choose where data is stored. The nearest items say the onboarding Airwallex entity and available features depend on where the business is registered. That is an adjacent legal-entity and licensing fact, not a user-selectable data-storage region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
